what: Chapter entrance animations break the engine's motion budget: 700ms-1.4s durations, an overshoot curve, built-in `ease-out`/`ease-in-out`, and translate-only entrances with no scale.

fix: Before: `animation: ch6-drop 900ms cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.4,1.4)` → After: `animation: ch6-drop var(--dur-move) var(--ease-out)` with `from { transform: translateY(-16px) scale(.95); opacity: 0 }` (one-shot story motion can stay playful but should land inside ~300ms, from a visible start). Same for slide (700ms → var(--dur-ui)), post (1.1s → 280ms), flip/tip (1.2-1.4s ease-in-out → 300ms var(--ease-out), or delete: a rocking switch adds no meaning).
